name: Onegai O-Hoshi-sama
source:
A "wish star" able to fulfill any wish falls down in a meteor shower. However, it has so many wishes that there is no room for new ones. Moreover, all these naughty wishes seek a way to be realized. Three friends are chosen for this purpose. What will happen with them and horny girls coming from the star?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一顆能夠實現任何願望的「許願星」隨著流星雨墜落。然而，它承載的願望實在太多，已經沒有空間容納新的願望。更麻煩的是，這些淘氣的願望都在尋找讓自己實現的方法。三名朋友被選中來完成這件事。他們與來自星星的好色女孩們將會遭遇什麼？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
